title: Opening the Black Box: a free, self-paced course in explainable AI for large language models
description: A free, self-paced course in explainable AI for large language models. Five days of guided material built on thirteen open lab notebooks: attribution, attention analysis, probing, counterfactuals, adversarial testing, evaluation of explanations, chain-of-thought faithfulness, and mechanistic interpretability. The course page is served from this repository. The lab notebooks live in a separate MIT-licensed repository (10.5281/zenodo.21804605).
